defects.finding: Old generic type27 pedestal drew underneath dedicated Host. Generic pedestal is now excluded when the actor has dedicated Host runtime.
Stationary stem floated above terrain; explicit ground root now grounds stationary/walking bodies, retaining Floast hover.
Early frame10 closed capture preceded camera settling and obscured body behind cliff; frame180 captures used instead. Runtime unchanged.

limitations: Natural Mobile Host overlaps the protagonist in cliff shadow. Contact readability still needs full combat acceptance.
Floast isolated open view is near the bottom edge; its closed view shows hovering skull near the far wall.
FPS overlays are incidental measurements while other build/test tasks ran. No controlled performance gate claimed.

Natural Flesh Mobile Host did not emit an observed projectile during the browser sample; its isolated case did, and native tests cover attacks. Seeded case establishes reachability and runtime state only.
